_meta.description: Songs directory — link-out only. Each entry contains title + URL + auto-derived language and theme tags. The app does not host audio, lyrics, or PDFs; clicking an entry opens the original site (fydt.org / christiandiscipleschurch.org) where the church publishes its own content under its own license.
_meta.note: Theme tags are auto-derived from the title text using a keyword map; they are best-effort, not authoritative. The verse field is only populated for unambiguous cases like Psalm 23 settings.
_meta.mediaUrlNote: CDC entries have audioUrl + pdfUrl derived deterministically from the catalogue code; fydt entries have these populated by the sync script when it scrapes per-song pages. The app today still uses link-out (opening url in a new tab) — these direct media URLs are pre-populated so the app can switch to inline playback or PDF download once licensing is documented, with no further data work.
